eagle_wings.title: Forgotten Island
eagle_wings.description: Follows two best friends who become stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only escape might cost them their shared lifetime of memories

eagle_wings.title: Heart Of The Beast
eagle_wings.description: After a harrowing plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements

filmhouse.title: Love Letter (4K Restoration)
filmhouse.description: Still grieving the tragic loss of her fiancé Itsuki Fujii in a mountain climbing accident, Hiroko Watanabe sends a letter to his old childhood address in snow-covered Otaru, a home she believes no longer exists, hoping to send a message into the ether. To her shock, she receives a reply signed by "Itsuki Fujii." The respondent is not her late lover's ghost, but a female former classmate who shared his exact name. As the two women begin exchanging letters across the snowbound landscape, a tender, long buried portrait of forgotten youth, unrequited first love, and shared memory slowly unfurls. A foundational landmark of 1990s Asian cinema, Shunji Iwai’s feature debut became a massive cultural phenomenon across East and Southeast Asia, immortalized by Miho Nakayama’s double performance. Shot with a dreamlike, soft focus palette by the late cinematographer Noboru Shinoda, this new 4K digital restoration preserves every delicate detail. 4K remastering under the supervision of Fuji Television Network, Inc., with all analog and digital processes by Imagica Entertainment Media Services, Inc. Image digitization through high-resolution 4K scanning from the original 35mm camera negative. Restoration, color correction, and final sound finishing supervised by director Shunji Iwai. In Japanese with English subtitles. Rated PG Presented at Filmhouse as part of Japanese Film Festival, in partnership with the Singapore Film Society, Japan Creative Center and Japan Foundation

filmhouse.title: The Violinist
filmhouse.description: Set across the shifting landscape of colonial Singapore and wartime Malaya, two musically gifted childhood friends—Fei and Kai—are bound together by their shared devotion to the violin. When the brutal onset of World War II and the Japanese Occupation tears them apart, Fei embarks on a decades-long journey across a changing Southeast Asia, holding onto memory, resilience, and the power of music as she searches for her lost friend. A landmark achievement for local cinema, co-directors Ervin Han and Raúl García’s hand-drawn feature made history by winning the prestigious Cristal Award for Best Feature at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, alongside the SACEM Award for Best Original Soundtrack. Blending meticulous traditional craft with an evocative score by Ricky Ho, the film transforms regional history into a deeply human, universally resonant story that demands to be experienced on the big screen Director Q&A, Sunday 4 Oct Join us for an in-person Q&A with Co-Director Ervin Han , alongside Art Director and Storyboard Artist Ong Ruwei , Character Designer Sakura Wong and Animation Supervisor Wendy Li . In English with English and Mandarin subtitles. Rated PG for Some Violence

filmhouse.title: What We Do in the Shadows
filmhouse.description: In modern-day Wellington, New Zealand, a group of centuries-old vampires share a suburban flat and struggle with the mundane realities of modren domestic life. When a camera crew documents their daily routines, the arrival of a newly turned vampire and his human software-engineer friend introduces the ancient flatmates to contemporary culture, forcing them to adapt to the 21st century. Driven by razor-sharp improvisation, deadpan comedy, and inventive visual gags, this Taika Waititi classic offers a brilliant, endearing subversion of classic creature-feature tropes, earning its status as a cult classic. In English. Rated NC16 for Some Violence and Nudity.

filmhouse.title: Digger
filmhouse.description: Digger Rockwell (Tom Cruise) is a megalomaniacal oil tycoon and one of the most powerful men on the planet. When his reckless deep-sea drilling operation in Greenland triggers a catastrophic environmental disaster, Digger refuses to back down or accept blame. Instead, he launches a frantic, delusional public relations crusade to spin the catastrophe, attempting to convince an unraveling world that he is humanity’s ultimate savior before the consequences of his hubris destroy everything. Four-time Academy Award winner Alejandro González Iñárritu ( Birdman , The Revenant ) returns to English language filmmaking with a blistering, absurdist black comedy. Anchored by Cruise’s most unhinged, transformative lead performance in decades, the film features a stellar supporting ensemble including Sandra Hüller, Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, and Jesse Plemons. Shot entirely on 35mm VistaVision by master cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki, Digger pairs razor sharp political satire with sweeping visual scale, an audacious, large-format spectacle engineered specifically for the big screen experience. In English with English & Chinese subtitles Rated M18 for Coarse Language.

filmhouse.title: Moonlight (10th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Framed across three pivotal eras of his life, Chiron navigates the harsh realities of growing up in a tough neighborhood while struggling with his identity, sexuality, and a troubled home environment. Guided by the tender mentorship of a local drug dealer and a deep, enduring connection with a childhood friend, Chiron gradually leanrs to protect himself from the world as he grows into adulthood. Directed by Barry Jenkins, this groundbreaking drama won three Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Supporting Actor for Mahershala Ali. Celebrated for James Laxton’s luminous cinematography and Nicholas Britell’s evocative score, the film stands as a transcendent, deeply lyrical portrait of intimacy, vulnerability, and self-discovery. Newly restored in 4K and with an exclusive conversation with director Barry Jenkins, featuring Oscar Nominated composer Nicholas Britell and Oscar winner Mahershala Ali, to follow the feature. In English. Rated M18 for Some Homosexual Content.

filmhouse.title: The Education of Jane Cumming
filmhouse.description: Edinburgh, 1810. Teachers Jane Pirie and Marianne Woods embark on their dream of an independent life together and open a boarding school. Their lives are changed forever when a wealthy aristocrat enrols her "illegitimate" 15-year-old grandchild from India. The teachers struggle to integrate the girl who remains an outsider among her classmates. Miss Pirie and Miss Woods are brought closer to Jane Cumming when her grandmother insists they look after her over the summer. Private and professional lines blur, affection between them grows and they start to form an unlikely family. Tensions rise as the new term begins. The teachers are overwhelmed with the girl's increasing desire for closeness and their own changing relationship. As Jane Cumming begins to feel excluded from her new family, she demands to be taken home to her grandmother. An accusation follows which leaves the teacher's fighting for their lives, resulting in a legal battle that would last a decade and scandalize the Scottish establishment. Based on true events. In English. Rating R21 . Some Homosexual Content Co-presented by Goethe-Institut Singapore & Embassy of Switzerland in Singapore

filmhouse.title: Fjord
filmhouse.description: The Gheorghius, a devout Romanian Norwegian couple, resettle in a village set in a distant fjord where they become close to their neighbours, the Halbergs. Their children bond despite their different education. When adolescent Elia Gheorghiu shows up at school with some bruises on her body, the community asks itself if the traditional education that the Gheorghiu children get from their parents might have anything to do with it. Winner of the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival, Fjord marks another masterclass in moral ambiguity from director Cristian Mungiu (4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days, R.M.N.). Anchored by magnetic, career-defining performances from Stan and Reinsve, the film dissects the terrifying machinery of state intervention with surgical narrative precision. Framed in stark long-take cinematography that captures the icy, claustrophobic grandeur of its Scandinavian setting, Fjord is an explosive, thought-provoking drama bound to spark debate. In Romanian and Norwegian with English subtitles. Rated NC16 for Some Nudity. TW: Contains depictions of self-harm.

filmhouse.title: Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust
filmhouse.description: Set in a future gothic wasteland where ancient vampires dominate a fading world, "D" a half vampire, half human bounty hunter is hired to retrieve a wealthy family's daughter abducted by a powerful vampire nobleman. Racing against the ruthless Markus Brothers, a rival band of mercenary hunters, D encounters a complex web of forbidden romance, tragic monstrousness, and dark fantasy. Widely regarded as Kawajiri’s directorial masterpiece, Bloodlust showcases the artistry of pre digital, hand drawn Japanese animation with its blend of Baroque grandeur, dark romanticism, and dazzling action choreography. The 2K restoration elevates Yoshitaka Amano's breathtaking character designs and painterly background art, restoring the film's velvet shadow tones and fine line work to pristine quality In Japanese with English subtitles. Rated PG13 for Some Violence and Nudity. TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosensitive viewers are advised.

filmhouse.title: Kokuho
filmhouse.description: Following its phenomenal success in Japan, critically acclaimed film Kokuho is enjoying a re-release in Singapore with limited screenings! Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Lee Sang-il and adapted from Shuichi Yoshida's bestselling novel of the same name, Kokuho stars Ryo Yoshizawa and Ryusei Yokohama alongside an impressive ensemble cast including Ken Watanabe. Set in the fascinating world of Kabuki, Japan's centuries-old traditional performing art, Kokuho tells the story of two young men from very different backgrounds whose lives become intertwined through their pursuit perfecting their craft. More than just a story about performance, Kokuho is a powerful portrait of ambition, identity and the price of dedicating one's life to art. Recognised by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, Kabuki is celebrated for its rich traditions, elaborate costumes and stylised performances. One of its most iconic features is “onnagata”, the art of male actors portraying female roles with extraordinary precision, grace and emotional depth. Since its release, Kokuho has become the highest-grossing live-action Japanese film in history. Domestic and global popularity of the film has also rekindled public interest in kabuki. The film dominated the 49th Japan Academy Film Prize, taking home ten awards, including Best Picture, Best Director and Best Actor. Its exceptional Kabuki-inspired hair and makeup artistry also earned a nomination for Best Makeup and Hairstyling at the 98th Academy Awards, bringing the beauty of Japanese traditional culture to the global stage. In Japanese with English and Mandarin dual subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual Scenes.

filmhouse.title: Five Broken Cameras
filmhouse.description: Five broken cameras – and each one has a powerful tale to tell. Embedded in the bullet-ridden remains of digital technology is the story of Emad Burnat, a farmer from the Palestinian village of Bil’in, which famously chose nonviolent resistance when the Israeli army encroached upon its land to make room for Jewish colonists. Emad bought his first camera in 2005 to document the birth of his fourth son, Gibreel. Over the course of the film, he becomes the peaceful archivist of an escalating struggle as olive trees are bulldozed, lives are lost, and a wall is built to segregate burgeoning Israeli settlements. In Arabic with English subtitles Rated NC16 for Mature Content. This screening is held in conjunction with Letter to Birds , part of the ticket proceeds will be donated to Mercy Relief . Letter to Birds is an art market organised by artists, raising funds for humanitarian aid in Palestine. Now in its third edition, it returns to Filmhouse on Sunday, 18 October with over 50 artists participating!

filmhouse.title: Before Sunrise
filmhouse.description: An unexpected meeting on a train leads two travelers to spend an evening wandering through Vienna. As the night unfolds, they share stories and conversations about life and love, exploring new ideas while a quiet intimacy grows between them, knowing it may be their only night together. In English. Rated NC16.

filmhouse.title: Fatherland
filmhouse.description: FATHERLAND centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika, actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins – from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also deep fracture within his own family. In German with English subitltes . Rating NC16. Some Mature Content Co-presented by Goethe-Institut Singapore, Embassy of Italy in Singapore & Embassy of the Republic of Poland in Singapore TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosentive audience is advised.

filmhouse.title: Perfect Days
filmhouse.description: Hirayama works as a cleaner of public toilets in Tokyo, leading a quiet, contentment-driven life structured around classic rock cassettes, secondhand books, and photographing the light filtering through urban trees. As small, unexpected encounters break his daily routine, quiet details of his past gradually come to light. Directed by Wim Wenders, this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature earned Kōji Yakusho the Best Actor prize at the Cannes Film Festival. Celebrating the dignity of labor and the art of mindfulness, the film offers a warm, contemplative, and visually striking observation of contemporary Tokyo. In Japanese with English subitles. Rated PG for Brief Nudity

filmhouse.title: Aftersun
filmhouse.description: On a quiet summer holiday at a Turkish resort in the late 1990s, 11-year-old Sophie spends precious days with her loving, idealistic father, Calum. Decades later, an adult Sophie revisits home video footage and fragmented memories from the trip, attempting to reconcile the father she remembered with the personal struggles he kept hidden from view. Charlotte Wells’ remarkable debut feature earned Paul Mescal an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor alongside the French Touch Prize at the Cannes Film Festival. A deeply felt portrait of memory, grief, and parental love, the film pairs subtle visual storytelling with remarkable central performances that linger long after the credits roll. In English. Rated M18 for Mature Content. TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosensitive audiences are advised.

filmhouse.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
filmhouse.description: Haru, a competitive ballroom dancer in Tokyo, finds her world shattered when a sudden tragedy takes her husband-cum-dance partner from her side. Withdrawn into deep isolation and grief, she slowly allows her friends to coax her back onto the floor, where an unexpected connection with a new instructor reignites her passion. As she navigates life after loss, Haru stumbles through awkward choices, finding that healing is an exuberant, messy, and wildly colorful process. Featuring a charismatic lead performance by Rinko Kikuchi(Pacific Rim), the film presents an energetic, unabashed and fantastical way of moving on. In Japanese, Spanish and English with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual Scene and Mature Content.

filmhouse.title: La La Land (10th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart. In English with Mandarin Subtitles Rated PG13 for Some Coarse Language

filmhouse.title: A Poet
filmhouse.description: Oscar is an aging, rueful poet whose artistic ambitions have long faded into obscurity and heavy drinking. When Oscar takes up teaching to meet ends meet, he encounters Yurlady, a working-class girl with an extraordinary gift for poetry, he becomes consumed with launching her talent into the local literary scene. Driven by a desperate longing for career redemption and a second chance at fatherhood, Oscar inadvertently pushes her into an ambitious world she never asked to join. Directed by Simón Mesa Soto, this tragicomedy earned the Un Certain Regard Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival and represented Colombia as its official submission for Best International Feature Film. Anchored by a brilliant, cringe-inducing performance from Ubeimar Rios, the film offers a darkly funny and deeply humane satire on artist egos and the messy search for purpose. A Poet, A Creative, A Panel Join us for a post-show fireside chat on Tue 6 Oct, 7.30pm ! Do you dream of writing your story one day? Of writing novels, poetry, or making films? Do you want to support those dreamers around us to do so? It isn’t easy being an artist anywhere, especially not outside major commercial systems like America, the UK, and Hollywood. And though A POET comes from halfway across the world, our creative industries are really not so different. So why make the admirably Herculean task of creating any harder by keeping career wisdom behind closed doors (or gates), or by having to struggle alone? And if you care about local voices, then how can we best support our artists? Join us for a fireside chat with a local poet, Theophilus Kwek , and filmmaker, Pek Jia Hao , as they share with us their uncensored stories, tips and tricks, and dreams for the creative life in Singapore. In Spanish with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Nudity.

filmhouse.title: A Poet
filmhouse.description: Oscar is an aging, rueful poet whose artistic ambitions have long faded into obscurity and heavy drinking. When Oscar takes up teaching to meet ends meet, he encounters Yurlady, a working-class girl with an extraordinary gift for poetry, he becomes consumed with launching her talent into the local literary scene. Driven by a desperate longing for career redemption and a second chance at fatherhood, Oscar inadvertently pushes her into an ambitious world she never asked to join. Directed by Simón Mesa Soto, this tragicomedy earned the Un Certain Regard Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival and represented Colombia as its official submission for Best International Feature Film. Anchored by a brilliant, cringe-inducing performance from Ubeimar Rios, the film offers a darkly funny and deeply humane satire on artist egos and the messy search for purpose. And though A POET comes from halfway across the world, our creative industries are really not so different. So why make the admirably Herculean task of creating any harder by keeping career wisdom behind closed doors (or gates), or by having to struggle alone? And if you care about local voices, then how can we best support our artists? Join us for a fireside chat with a local poet, Theophilus Kwek , and filmmaker, Pek Jia Hao , as they share with us their uncensored stories, tips and tricks, and dreams for the creative life in Singapore. In Spanish with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Nudity.

filmhouse.title: The Violinist
filmhouse.description: Set across the shifting landscape of colonial Singapore and wartime Malaya, two musically gifted childhood friends—Fei and Kai—are bound together by their shared devotion to the violin. When the brutal onset of World War II and the Japanese Occupation tears them apart, Fei embarks on a decades-long journey across a changing Southeast Asia, holding onto memory, resilience, and the power of music as she searches for her lost friend. A landmark achievement for local cinema, co-directors Ervin Han and Raúl García’s hand-drawn feature made history by winning the prestigious Cristal Award for Best Feature at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, alongside the SACEM Award for Best Original Soundtrack. Blending meticulous traditional craft with an evocative score by Ricky Ho, the film transforms regional history into a deeply human, universally resonant story that demands to be experienced on the big screen Director Q&A, Sunday 4 Oct Join us for an in-person Q&A with Co-Director Ervin Han , alongside Art Director and Storyboard Artist Ong Ruwei , Character Designer Sakura Wong and Animation Supervisor Wendy Li . In English with English and Mandarin subtitles. Rated PG for Some Violence

filmhouse.title: Anatomy of a Fall
filmhouse.description: When a man falls to his death from a remote chalet in the French Alps, his wife—a successful German novelist—becomes the prime suspect in a murder trial. With no direct witnesses other than their visually impaired young son, the courtroom proceedings gradually shift from analyzing physical evidence to dissecting the private fractures of their marriage. Winner of the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival and the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay, Justine Triet’s psychological drama is a masterclass in narrative tension and moral ambiguity. Powered by a commanding performance from Sandra Hüller, it is a sharp, provocative examination of truth, perspective, and relationship dynamics. In French and English with English subtitles. Rated NC16 for Some Mature References. TW: Contains scene(s) of animal abuse.

filmhouse.title: Moonlight (10th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Framed across three pivotal eras of his life, Chiron navigates the harsh realities of growing up in a tough neighborhood while struggling with his identity, sexuality, and a troubled home environment. Guided by the tender mentorship of a local drug dealer and a deep, enduring connection with a childhood friend, Chiron gradually leanrs to protect himself from the world as he grows into adulthood. Directed by Barry Jenkins, this groundbreaking drama won three Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Supporting Actor for Mahershala Ali. Celebrated for James Laxton’s luminous cinematography and Nicholas Britell’s evocative score, the film stands as a transcendent, deeply lyrical portrait of intimacy, vulnerability, and self-discovery. Newly restored in 4K and with an exclusive conversation with director Barry Jenkins, featuring Oscar Nominated composer Nicholas Britell and Oscar winner Mahershala Ali, to follow the feature. In English. Rated M18 for Some Homosexual Content.

filmhouse.title: Fjord
filmhouse.description: The Gheorghius, a devout Romanian Norwegian couple, resettle in a village set in a distant fjord where they become close to their neighbours, the Halbergs. Their children bond despite their different education. When adolescent Elia Gheorghiu shows up at school with some bruises on her body, the community asks itself if the traditional education that the Gheorghiu children get from their parents might have anything to do with it. Winner of the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival, Fjord marks another masterclass in moral ambiguity from director Cristian Mungiu (4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days, R.M.N.). Anchored by magnetic, career-defining performances from Stan and Reinsve, the film dissects the terrifying machinery of state intervention with surgical narrative precision. Framed in stark long-take cinematography that captures the icy, claustrophobic grandeur of its Scandinavian setting, Fjord is an explosive, thought-provoking drama bound to spark debate. In Romanian and Norwegian with English subtitles. Rated NC16 for Some Nudity. TW: Contains depictions of self-harm.

filmhouse.title: Digger
filmhouse.description: Digger Rockwell (Tom Cruise) is a megalomaniacal oil tycoon and one of the most powerful men on the planet. When his reckless deep-sea drilling operation in Greenland triggers a catastrophic environmental disaster, Digger refuses to back down or accept blame. Instead, he launches a frantic, delusional public relations crusade to spin the catastrophe, attempting to convince an unraveling world that he is humanity’s ultimate savior before the consequences of his hubris destroy everything. Four-time Academy Award winner Alejandro González Iñárritu ( Birdman , The Revenant ) returns to English language filmmaking with a blistering, absurdist black comedy. Anchored by Cruise’s most unhinged, transformative lead performance in decades, the film features a stellar supporting ensemble including Sandra Hüller, Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, and Jesse Plemons. Shot entirely on 35mm VistaVision by master cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki, Digger pairs razor sharp political satire with sweeping visual scale, an audacious, large-format spectacle engineered specifically for the big screen experience. In English with English & Chinese subtitles Rated M18 for Coarse Language.

filmhouse.title: Stop Making Sense (4K Restoration)
filmhouse.description: Some movies are meant to be watched in quiet contemplation; others demand to be experienced as a party. We are cranking up Filmhouse’s 7.1 sound system to present the definitive 4K restoration of Talking Heads’ cinematic milestone in all its high volume glory! Captured over three nights at Hollywood’s Pantages Theatre in 1983, Jonathan Demme’s concert film opens on an empty stage with David Byrne, an acoustic guitar, and a portable cassette player performing "Psycho Killer." Musician by musician, instrument by instrument, the stage is constructed before the audience's eyes, escalating into an exhilarating, high energy spectacle driven by Talking Heads at the peak of their live performance powers. Whether you're a lifelong fan or discovering the iconic big suit for the first time, join us for an unmissable communal screening that bridges the gap between cinema and live concert! In English. Rated PG TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosensitive audiences are advised.

filmhouse.title: Kokuho
filmhouse.description: Following its phenomenal success in Japan, critically acclaimed film Kokuho is enjoying a re-release in Singapore with limited screenings! Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Lee Sang-il and adapted from Shuichi Yoshida's bestselling novel of the same name, Kokuho stars Ryo Yoshizawa and Ryusei Yokohama alongside an impressive ensemble cast including Ken Watanabe. Set in the fascinating world of Kabuki, Japan's centuries-old traditional performing art, Kokuho tells the story of two young men from very different backgrounds whose lives become intertwined through their pursuit perfecting their craft. More than just a story about performance, Kokuho is a powerful portrait of ambition, identity and the price of dedicating one's life to art. Recognised by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, Kabuki is celebrated for its rich traditions, elaborate costumes and stylised performances. One of its most iconic features is “onnagata”, the art of male actors portraying female roles with extraordinary precision, grace and emotional depth. Since its release, Kokuho has become the highest-grossing live-action Japanese film in history. Domestic and global popularity of the film has also rekindled public interest in kabuki. The film dominated the 49th Japan Academy Film Prize, taking home ten awards, including Best Picture, Best Director and Best Actor. Its exceptional Kabuki-inspired hair and makeup artistry also earned a nomination for Best Makeup and Hairstyling at the 98th Academy Awards, bringing the beauty of Japanese traditional culture to the global stage. In Japanese with English and Mandarin dual subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual Scenes.

Never After Dark [JPN]
upcoming.description: A wandering medium, Airi spends her life guiding restless spirits out of the world of the living. Summoned to an isolated country house, she comes face to face with a grotesque apparition with powers that defy Airi’s experience. As she digs deeper into the house’s past, a secret comes to light — and Airi finds herself hunted by a far more unpredictable force. For the first time, her greatest adversary is not the supernatural, but the living…

upcoming.title: Oh My Ghost! Oh My God! [M]
upcoming.description:
Japanese pop star Juliet travels to a village in Taiwan to fulfil her late mother’s final wish of reconnecting with her ancestral roots. She embarks on a journey into a sacred mountain with her childhood friend Amuy, Amuy’s boyfriend, and her sceptical manager.
After unknowingly violating ancient taboos, the group gets trapped in a mist-covered forest where vengeful spirits prey on their deepest fears. To escape, they must confront both the ancient spirits and the truths they have long tried to bury.

upcoming.title: Wildwood
upcoming.description: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel (Peyton Elizabeth Lee) launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness—an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay), Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition

upcoming.title: Henry's First Dates (THAI)
upcoming.description:
They say the first date is the most exciting moment in any relationship —
a feeling you only get once! Except for ‘Lucy’ (Minnie Nicha Yontararak), who’s
living her first date on repeat with ‘Henry’ (Nadech Kugimiya), a good-natured,
animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can’t
remember anything from the day before. So, Lucy has to find a way to keep
wooing Henry, to make him fall in love with her every singe day. And that’s before
she even gets past his family and the people closest to him: Dad (Kiat Kitjaroen),
Ka-noon (Ble Patoomrach), and Auntie Su (Tipagorn Chaiprasit). Can Lucy make
Henry fall for her, again and again? Or will he forget her… forever?

upcoming.title: Sense And Sensibility
upcoming.description: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

upcoming.title: The Mongoose
upcoming.description: A highly decorated combat vet, Ryan ''Fang'' Flanagan, is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour in a Mustang Shelby Super Snake GT350.

upcoming.title: The Weight
upcoming.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

upcoming.title: V [CANTO]
upcoming.description: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once "paved with gold", had fallen into a state of broken order and rampant crime. Worker Man Zi-Keung (Zhu Yilong) is determined to rewrite his fate.

upcoming.description:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

There is no third time. Everything ends here.

upcoming.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend (IMAX) (TAM)
upcoming.description: Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi.

upcoming.title: The Cat in the Hat
upcoming.description: In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, doing what he does best— spreading joy to “happyless” kids. In the film, The Cat takes on his toughest assignment yet… to cheer a pair of siblings struggling with their move to a new town.

upcoming.title: The Land Of Sometimes
upcoming.description: Twins Alfie and Elise find a magical Wish Watch on Christmas Eve and are swept by the Wish Collector into the musical Land of Sometimes, where they learn that wishes have consequences.

upcoming.title: Jupiter [FRE]
upcoming.description: Newly elected French President Paul Archambault is summoned to the Élysée’s nuclear bunker as an international crisis erupts. After surviving an assassination attempt, the Russian president blames Ukraine and threatens retaliation. With nuclear war looming, Archambault faces his first - and most dangerous - test : how far will he go to prevent catastrophe ?

upcoming.title: Just An illusion [FRE]
upcoming.description:
It’s 1985, and almost-thirteen-year-old Vincent is growing up in the Paris suburbs, caught between childhood and adulthood. With his parents constantly arguing and his older
brother barely noticing him, he turns to friends, first crushes, and new questions about identity. Funny, tender, and awkward, Vincent’s journey is a first step toward figuring out who he wants to be.

upcoming.title: A Place For Her [FRE]
upcoming.description: Dr. Diane Khoury runs a vital care centre that gives vulnerable women a safe haven. Alongside her dedicated team, she helps them through personal and social crises while keeping the centre afloat. But when government auditors threaten its already fragile finances, Diane is forced to fight for the women who depend on her, and the team she calls family.

upcoming.title: De Gaulle I : The Sovereign Age [FRE]
upcoming.description:
June 1940. After France falls to German occupation, an obscure general escapes to London and calls on the French to resist. At first alone and without support, he gradually inspires soldiers, students, and resistance fighters in France, Britain, and Africa to join his cause. Their courage and determination lay the foundations of a
resistance movement that will challenge the course of history.

upcoming.title: De Gaulle II : Tilting Iron [FRE]
upcoming.description: As France remains under occupation, de Gaulle fights to establish Free France against Roosevelt’s ambitions and Allied plans. From London to Africa, from Jean Moulin’s underground Resistance to Leclerc and the 2nd Armored Division, the fight is on to liberate France and restore its sovereignty. As Paris rises, de Gaulle faces a decisive political and military battle for the future of France.

upcoming.title: De La Comédie-Française [FRE]
upcoming.description: At the Comédie-Française, the show must go on. Three hours before Nina’s first premiere, everything falls apart: an actor is stuck on a train, tempers flare, equipment breaks, and panic spreads backstage. With the clock ticking, Nina must hold her cast and crew together and pull off the impossible before the curtain rises.

upcoming.title: Ebenezer
upcoming.description: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The name you know, the story you don’t. EBENEZER follows a miserly businessman who is forced through visions of the past, present, and future during a supernatural journey toward a chance at redemption.

upcoming.title: How To Rob A Bank
upcoming.description: Nicholas Hoult and Pete Davidson are part of a group of bank robbers who share their heists on social media in this tongue-in-cheek thriller from the director of Bullet Train.

upcoming.title: Muyi And The Handsome General [FRE]
upcoming.description:
Fourteen-year-old Muyi lives with two friends on a secluded Chinese mountain where men are forbidden. When she invites a famous opera troupe to perform in her village, their
arrival awakens an ancient Spirit and throws everything into chaos. Muyi must journey through ancient China, where mythology, time travel and rebellion collide, and discover the courage to rewrite her own destiny.

upcoming.title: Santiago : The Camino Therapy [FRE]
upcoming.description: Adam, a troubled teenager, is given an unusual alternative to punishment : walk 800 kilometers along the Camino de Santiago. Accompanied by Fred, a tough woman haunted by her past, he embarks on a journey of endurance and self-discovery. As they confront exhaustion, conflict, and painful memories, an unexpected bond grows between them, helping both find the strength to change their lives.

upcoming.title: THE BEAST
upcoming.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.

upcoming.title: The Electric Kiss [FRE]
upcoming.description:
Early 20th-century Paris. Haunted by his wife Irène’s death, painter Antoine Balestro has lost his ability to create. Desperate to contact her, he turns to a medium, but instead finds Suzanne, a penniless sideshow performer who has slipped into the clairvoyant’s caravan looking for food. A
chance encounter is about to blur the line between fraud, love, and the supernatural.

upcoming.title: Women On Trial [FRE]
upcoming.description: 1972. Marie-Claire, a young woman prosecuted for an illegal abortion, faces prison alongside her mother and two women who helped her. When renowned lawyer Gisèle Halimi takes on the case, she turns the trial into a powerful challenge to the laws and social order that punish women. Their fight becomes a defining moment in the struggle for women’s rights in France.

upcoming.title: Ah Girl [M]
upcoming.description: Seven-year-old Ah Girl (Ong Xuan Jing) is growing up fast in 1990s Singapore. Her parents are separated and she lives with lazy, charming Pa (James Seah), naughty sister Ah Tian (Sydney Wong) and grumpy Ah Ma (Doreen Toh), while craving affection from aloof Mummy (Carrie Wong). Despite the chaos and conflict of her broken family, Ah Girl finds time to collect spiders, have a crush, and sell bubblegum, but can she stay true to herself when the adults threaten to make things worse?

upcoming.title: I Play Rocky
upcoming.description: Sylvester Stallone, then a failing actor, writes the ultimate underdog story and must fight for his chance to play the role of a lifetime - Rocky Balboa.

upcoming.title: The Phantom of The Opera [FRE]
upcoming.description: In present-day Paris, dancer Anastasia joins the Opéra Garnier. While rehearsing the cursed opera Orpheus, supposedly written by the Phantom, she falls for a mysterious pianist. As opening night approaches, strange accidents occur.

upcoming.title: Disney's Hexed
upcoming.description: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

upcoming.title: Focker In-Law
upcoming.description: The circle of trust just got bigger. This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

upcoming.title: Winter Of The Crow (POLISH)
upcoming.description: A British professor witnesses a student's murder by secret police in 1981 Warsaw under martial law. She becomes a target while running through the city's streets, eventually forced to stop and take a stand.

upcoming.title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
upcoming.description: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

upcoming.title: Bitter Christmas (SPANISH)
upcoming.description: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.

Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell).

upcoming.description: Garance is a young actress but not a star. She manages things as best she can, finding fuel and comfort in alcohol. As she embarks for an eight-year journey of life changes, she drinks more and more. Until death seems to loom.
